contexts.text: (The food with which the life of good Spirits and Angels is sustained.)
With this food evil Spirits are sustained.
Sustentation thence. Signified, Explained.
Truth is the support of good, as the bones are of the flesh.
That he would sustain the truths which they had. Signified, Explained.

There will I sustain thee () = a continual influx of spiritual life... Sustentation, in the spiritual sense, is nothing else than an influx of good and truth through Heaven from the Lord; from this are the Angels sustained, and from this is the soul of man sustained. To this sustentation corresponds the sustentation of the external man by food and drink.
Sustentation by good and truth meanwhile. Signified.
Pasture = that which sustains the spiritual life... (for) scientifics and truths sustain the soul of man. AC 6078:2, Illustrated.
(In this case) scientifics do indeed sustain the interior life of man, but his natural and not his spiritual life.
Joseph sustained his father and his brethren... with bread () = from the Internal Celestial a continual influx of good...
That they were sustained by it. Signified.
As to the sustentation of the spiritual life. Signified. AC 6121.
Sustentation by means of the influx of good from the Internal. Signified, Explained.
The effect of repeated desolations and sustentations.

I will sustain you and your infants () = that they should live through the Internal... by means of the truth which is of the understanding and of the good which is of the will; for to sustain = the influx of good and truth.
That they had with them no other sustentation from truth and good. Signified, Explained.
He who is in spiritual life desires the sustentation of it by... the goods and truths of faith...
They stayed up his hands () = the sustentation of the power of combating truth.
Lest their numbers should increase beyond what that Earth can support.
They who ascribe to nature the origin and maintenance of all things.
For truths from the Word, from which is doctrine, support the Word. Signified, Explained.
The good which supports that Heaven. Signified, Explained. AC 9641.
Plenary sustentation by means of truth. Signified, Explained.
Sustentation in every way by good, and by means of truth from good. Signified, Explained.
The good of merit... conjoining and supporting. Signified, Explained.
Pillars = sustentation. AC 9689.
The sustentation of the uniting medium, as much as is required, by means of the good of merit... Signified, Explained.
The goods of truth supporting fully. Signified, Explained.
Truths from good also supporting fully. Signified.
The goods and derivative truths also supporting as much as is required for uses. Signified, Explained.
All the good which supports Heaven. Signified, Explained.
The mode of conjunction [with] the things which sustain in the extremes. Signified, Explained.
Thus the sustentation of Heaven... Signified.
For sustentation is perpetual creation, AE 1215:end.
The Angels then have no support and foundation.
The Lord's Divine Natural as to the Divine love, which sustains all things. Signified, Explained.
A pillar = support.
That the sphere of the love of infants is the sphere of the protection and sustentation of those who cannot protect and sustain themselves. Explained.
The origin and sustentation of spiritual things is from a Sun which is pure love... and the origin and sustentation of natural things is a sun which is pure fire.
A pillar = Divine truth supporting.
The spiritual life needs nourishment and sustentation just as does the natural life...
The Divine truth, or the Word, in ultimates, sustaining the interior things therein. Signified, Explained.
Exactly as pillars sustain a house, or feet the body.
Therefore the Word in the letter may be called the support of Heaven.
The Salvation of the faithful thereby is meant by, His supporting us out of Zion ().
Thus the sense of the letter of our Word, is the basis, support, and support of the wisdom of the Angels...
